hook.name: QSimpleLaunch
hook.description: A launch factory and pool hook that creates token launches with configurable guards (trading open delay, anti-snipe, wallet cap, cooldown) and optional fee distribution (buy/sell tax, buyback-and-burn, referrals, creator vault). Fees are extracted via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta; launch liquidity positions are permanently locked with no owner or upgrade path.
